title: Western Science Meets Eastern Void: The Ku-Ma-Ki Framework as a Bridge Between Empirical Physics and Contemplative Cosmology
abstract: Western empirical science and Eastern contemplative cosmology have developed in near-total isolation for three centuries. The word kūki (空気, air) — literally void-ki — directly encodes the physical relationship between ku (空, void) and ki (気, outer surface propagation). The universe was speaking Japanese before physics knew what to call it.
